Smooth mortality data

Source: R/smoothing.R
smooth_mortality.Rd

Applies either a 2D tensor-product P-spline (via mgcv::gam()) or a 1D Whittaker smoother to a mort_data object, smoothing log(mx) over age and year (or year only for Whittaker).

Usage

smooth_mortality(
  x,
  method = c("gam", "whittaker"),
  ages = NULL,
  years = NULL,
  covid_years = integer(0),
  lambda = NULL,
  floor_threshold = 1e-07
)

Arguments

x

A mort_data object, or a 3D array [n_a x n_t x n_g].

method

One of "gam" (2D P-spline, recommended) or "whittaker" (1D time-only fallback).

ages

Integer vector of ages (required if x is a raw array).

years

Integer vector of years (required if x is a raw array).

covid_years

Integer vector of years to exclude (weight = 0).

lambda

Optional smoothing parameter for Whittaker (auto-selected if NULL).

floor_threshold

Mortality rates below this are treated as zero-count.

Value

If x is mort_data, a new mort_data with smoothed = TRUE. If x is a raw array, a list with arr (smoothed array) and method.
